correctness.rationale: Bounded inverse of M(j-1)+4M(j)+M(j+1) is the exact geometric Green kernel. The step has central variation 1 and symmetric overshoot tails of variation 2h/(1-q) each. All finite-variation sequences are absolutely summable combinations of translated steps modulo constants, proving the upper bound; a step attains it. Exact symbolic identities, quartic elimination, direct finite natural-spline critical-point integration and random-data diagnostics reproduced successfully. Those finite tests are not substituted for an infinite proof.
